_meta.definition: The process of managing geographical data related to cities, provinces, countries, mountains, languages, and religions.

city._description: Captures geographical and demographic information of cities worldwide.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores city names for Albanian cities.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-2 alpha-2 code of the country where each city is located.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores the country (Albania) for each city entry.

columns.name: Population
columns.description: Stores the number of inhabitants (in thousands) for each city.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: Stores geographical longitudes of cities in decimal degrees.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: Stores geographical latitude coordinates for cities.

ethnicGroup._description: Captures demographic data representing ethnic groups and their percentage distribution across various countries.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the two-letter ISO country code for the predominant nation of origin within each ethnic group.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of ethnic group names, such as Greeks, Albanians, and Serbs.

columns.name: Percentage
columns.description: Stores the proportion of individuals within each ethnic group in the Mondial database.

geo_mountain._description: Records geographical data of mountains, including their country and province locations.

columns.name: Mountain
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for prominent mountains worldwide.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO country code for the location of each mountain.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical provinces associated with mountain locations, as indicated by sample values.

language._description: Tracks linguistic composition of countries by recording their names and corresponding language percentages.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-alpha-2 country codes for languages predominantly spoken.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores the names of languages spoken in countries such as Albania, Macedonia, Turkey, Serbia.

columns.name: Percentage
columns.description: Stores the proportion of a language within the Mondial Corporation.

province._description: Represents geographical provinces within their respective countries, including details on population, area, capital city, and the relationship between capitals and provinces.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores the names of provinces in various formats, such as Albania, Anatoliki Makedhonia kai Thraki, etc.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-2 alpha-2 code of the country for each province.

columns.name: Population
columns.description: Stores the number of inhabitants for each province.

columns.name: Area
columns.description: Stores the square kilometers of each province.

columns.name: Capital
columns.description: Stores names of capital cities for provinces.

columns.name: CapProv
columns.description: Stores the names of provinces or regions in various formats across multiple countries.

religion._description: Tracks religious demographics by country and denomination.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries of religious affiliation.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores religious denominations such as Muslim, Roman Catholic, Christian Orthodox.

columns.name: Percentage
columns.description: Stores the proportion (as a percentage) of each country's population that follows a specific religion.
